title: sonerila zeylanica var. pumila
intro: Sonerila zeylanica var. pumila, commonly known as Ceylon plant or Sonerila, is a plant species that belongs to the family Melastomataceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sonerila zeylanica var. pumila are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
